claim: The Pont de les Peixateries Velles (Eiffel Bridge) was designed by Gustave Eiffel's company and completed in 1877, just before the Eiffel Tower; it is a bright red iron lattice bridge.
quote: Completed in 1877 ... designed by Gustave Eiffel's company just before he built the Eiffel Tower ... Bright red iron structure ... a striking contrast to the colorful riverside houses

claim: The Eiffel Bridge offers arguably the best view of Girona's cathedral and the Cases de l'Onyar, while Pont de Pedra gives views over the Cathedral and coloured houses; sunrise is the ideal shooting time.
quote: maybe the best view of Girona's cathedral and the Cases de l'Onyar ... Pont de Pedra ... views over the Cathedral and the famous coloured houses by the river ... wake up early, and you will have it all for yourself

claim: Girona's city walls are among the longest Carolingian walls in Europe (9th century), strollable via the Passeig de la Muralla, open Sept-May 8am-9pm and June-Aug 8am-11pm, with towers serving as vantage points.
quote: some sections of the longest Carolingian walls in Europe (9th century) ... September-May: from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. / June-August: from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m. ... The various towers are excellent vantage points offering views over the city

claim: The Passeig de la Muralla wall walk is completely free, takes about 1-2 hours, with access points near the Cathedral, Jardins dels Alemanys and Plaça Catalunya; Torre Gironella is the highest point with 360-degree views toward the Pyrenees.
quote: completely free to visit ... access points near the Girona Cathedral, Jardins dels Alemanys, and Plaça Catalunya ... Torre Gironella ... the highest point on the Girona City Walls ... 360-degree views

claim: The colourful houses are locally called Cases de l'Onyar; they were restored in 1983-1984 by the Fuses-Viader studio in a warm-colour palette, and golden hour before sunset gives the most vibrant reflections.
quote: locally known as 'Cases de l'Onyar' ... restoration of Cases de l'Onyar was made in 1983-1984 by the architect studio Fuses-Viader, following a warm-colored palette ... golden hour just before sunset
